localPatches.description: Use the SVG rendering container width for C4 layout instead of the physical screen width, retaining the original fallback when no container width is measurable.
Allocate branch positions using measured wrapped-label heights and leave measured clearance between adjacent category groups. Preserve the original tree, arrow direction, cause order and text.

Measure connected styled name and note rows, then place them within their semantic regions using bounded interval search. Preserve source, note identities, set values and circle geometry; expose an actionable diagnostic when placement fails.
Use the decision shape's own intersection helper when the block renderer copies its callback onto a graph node. Preserve polygon and endpoint geometry.
Infer grid alignments within each declared parent group; preserve explicit cross-group author hints. Prevent unrelated services and junctions from being forced inside group boundaries.
Own the temporary Cytoscape container directly, remove it after construction, and release each numerical layout core on preparation, layout or drawing failure and after successful output.

Expose a scoped numerical ELK postprocessor and preserve its obstacle-aware routes through native adaptation; keep native straightening for untouched layouts and restore the prior processor after each render.
Use complete measured service footprints for architecture spacing and group bounds; retain icon anchors and provide scoped shared routing for complete group connections and their qualifiers.
